$comment: Machine-readable index for the Wargaming Research Hub. The join key between raw captures in research/sources/ and the curated vault notes in Research/Notes/. The wargaming-researcher agent appends one entry per source. Keep `mechanics` in sync with the rows the note contributed to 'Wargaming Research Hub.md' — the hub is the human view, this is the queryable one.

verdicts.steal: do this, or something like it

evidence_tags.FACT: verifiable in a published rulebook, official document, or open-source implementation
evidence_tags.CONSENSUS: repeated, consistent community opinion — not a published number
evidence_tags.INFERENCE: our own derivation — label every time
evidence_tags.NOT_FOUND: searched, found nothing — state it rather than padding

sources.notes: Second capture for this game, scoped to Quantronic Combat (Hacking) and adjacent EW equipment/skills, per Ross's tech-layer sweep request. The earlier SWC costing entry above is untouched and kept intact. Biggest finding: Corvus Belli's own multi-edition trend (N3's five program families/seven device types collapsing into N5's two/four) is evidence that even the best-resourced publisher in the hobby has been shrinking hacking's scope, not growing it - read as validation that Settlements' current one-test v1 Hacking design is already the right size, not an under-built compromise.

sources.notes: Replaces a second-hand-summary entry (written from Ross's own paraphrase, not the rulebook) with a primary read of all 116 pages. The old note's central claim - a phrase quoted as 'the crooked SOBs get greedier' describing an economy-wide escalating bribe price - does not appear anywhere in the text (checked, NOT_FOUND) and overstated the mechanism: bribery escalation is a scoped, per-seat bidding war (18 exclusive seats total) with a spillover check limited to other seats in the same office category, not a global price rise. Card-driven activation and core D6 resolution covered but did not clear the hub-row bar (genre-conventional); no hub row given. Real but thin stealth mechanic found (Hiding + Creeping, SMARTS-gated, broken by noise) - first positive stealth data point after Zona Alfa's confirmed absence.
